title: Uko Wakuramo Videwo na Reels za Instagram kuri Telefoni na PC
description: Kuramo videwo na Reels za Instagram kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa nta app kandi nta kwinjira. Koporora link, uyomeke kuri I Need Save, uhitemo ubwiza.
photoCaption: Koporora link muri app ya Instagram.
photo2Caption: Omeka link ya Reels kuri I Need Save.
body:
Wigeze ubona Reels isekeje, isomo ryo guteka, cyangwa videwo igutera imbaraga wifuza kongera kureba nyuma utiriwe wongera kuyishakisha? Inkuru nziza: ushobora gukuramo videwo na Reels za Instagram ako kanya muri mushakisha ukoresheje I Need Save. Ntukeneye gushyiramo app, ntukeneye kwinjira, kandi biroroshye kimwe kuri telefoni no kuri mudasobwa.

Reka turebe intambwe, amadosiye ushobora kubona, n'ibintu bike ukwiye kumenya mbere yo gutangira.

Ni Ibihe Bikubiyemo bya Instagram Bishobora Gukurwamo?

I Need Save ikora ku nyandiko rusange za Instagram. Ibyo bivuze ko videwo cyangwa Reels zituruka kuri konti zidafunze akenshi ushobora kuzibika. Uretse videwo, ushobora no gukuramo ifoto cyangwa ifoto ntoya y'iyo nyandiko.

Hari ikintu kimwe ukwiye kumenya kuva mu ntangiriro: rimwe na rimwe Instagram ibuza ibisabwa cyangwa igasaba kwinjira. Iyo bibaye, gukuramo bishobora kwanga nubwo inyandiko ari rusange. Akenshi birahagije kongera kugerageza nyuma y'akanya gato.

Uko Wakuramo Reels za Instagram kuri Telefoni

Izi ntambwe zikora kuri Android no kuri iPhone.

  1. Fungura app ya Instagram maze ufungure Reels cyangwa videwo ushaka kubika.
  2. Kanda buto ya Sangiza (Share) kuri iyo nyandiko.
  3. Hitamo Koporora link (Copy link).
  4. Fungura mushakisha (browser) maze ujye kuri ineedsave.com.
  5. Omeka link mu gasanduku kabugenewe, cyangwa ukande buto ya Omeka kugira ngo byihute.
  6. Kanda Kuramo, hanyuma utegereze urutonde rw'amahitamo rugaragare.
  7. Hitamo ubwiza bwa videwo ushaka, maze dosiye itangire kuvamo.

Kuri videwo zimwe, buto ishobora kwandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…. Bisobanura ko videwo ibanza gutunganywa, urugero guhuza amashusho n'amajwi. Tegereza gusa, gukuramo biratangira ubwabyo dosiye imaze kwitegura.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo za Instagram kuri Mudasobwa

Niba ukunze gufungurira Instagram kuri mudasobwa, uburyo nabwo buroroshye:

  1. Fungura Instagram muri mushakisha maze ukande ku nyandiko ya videwo cyangwa Reels ushaka.
  2. Koporora link yayo ukoresheje menu ya Sangiza cyangwa aho bandika aderesi muri mushakisha.
  3. Fungura tab nshya, ujye ku rupapuro rwo gukuramo rwa I Need Save, hanyuma womeke link.
  4. Kanda Kuramo maze uhitemo ihitamo ukeneye.

Dosiye izabikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads bwa mudasobwa yawe.

Kuki Gukoresha Mushakisha Byoroshye Kurushaho?

Gukuramo ukoresheje urubuga bifite ibyiza byinshi. Ntukeneye gushyiramo app itwara umwanya, ntukeneye gutanga amakuru yo kwinjira, kandi uburyo ni bumwe ku bikoresho byose. Urubuga rwa I Need Save kandi ruboneka mu ndimi 93 kandi rukurikiza ubwarwo insanganyamatsiko y'urumuri cyangwa y'umwijima ya telefoni yawe, bityo ruhora rworoshye gukoresha. Uretse Instagram, ubu buryo ushobora no kubukoresha kuri TikTok, Facebook, X (Twitter) na Pinterest.

Amadosiye Ushobora Guhitamo

Link imaze gutunganywa, urabona amahitamo menshi. Umubare wayo n'ubwoko bwayo biterwa n'inyandiko y'umwimerere:

  • Videwo mu bwiza butandukanye, urugero 360p, 720p cyangwa 1080p.
  • Amajwi mu bwiza bw'umwimerere, cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo. Ni byiza niba ukeneye ijwi gusa cyangwa umuziki uri inyuma.
  • Ifoto / Ifoto ntoya y'inyandiko.

Inama: Niba ububiko bwa telefoni yawe butangiye kuzura, hitamo 720p. Ishusho iguma igaragara neza kuri ecran ya telefoni, ariko dosiye iba yoroheje kurusha iya 1080p.

Kubona Videwo Nyuma yo Kuyikuramo

Gukuramo nibirangira, dore aho dosiye yawe iri:

  • Android: fungura ububiko bwa Downloads ukoresheje app icunga amadosiye. App ya Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato mbere y'uko videwo igaragaramo.
  • iPhone/iPad (Safari): fungura app ya Files, hanyuma winjire mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Kugira ngo wimurire videwo muri app ya Photos, yifungure muri Files, ukande Share, hanyuma uhitemo Save Video.

Niba ukomeje kutabona dosiye, amabwiriza aho amadosiye wakuyemo abikwa kuri Android na iPhone abisobanura birambuye.

Ikindi kintu gituma utuza: dosiye iva kuri Instagram ijya ako kanya ku gikoresho cyawe, kandi ntibikwa kuri seriveri ya I Need Save.

Kuki Videwo ya Instagram Yanze Kuvamo?

Niba byanze, reba izi mpamvu zishoboka:

  • Inyandiko ituruka kuri konti yihariye. Ibikubiyemo byihariye ntibishobora gukurwamo.
  • Ibikubiyemo bishobora kurebwa gusa nyuma yo kwinjira, cyangwa byabujijwe mu turere tumwe.
  • Instagram irimo kubuza ibisabwa cyangwa gusaba kwinjira. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'akanya gato.
  • Link wometse si iy'inyandiko, urugero ni link ya profili. Yongere uyikoporore ukoresheje buto ya Sangiza ku nyandiko.

Ubaha Ibihangano by'Abahanzi

Koresha videwo wakuyemo ku giti cyawe gusa. Niba ushaka kuyongera gushyira ku rubuga, banza usabe uruhushya uwayikoze kandi uvuge izina rye neza. Abahanzi bakoze cyane kugira ngo bategure ibyo bikubiyemo, bityo uburenganzira bwabo bukwiye kubahwa.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ese nkeneye kwinjira kuri Instagram kugira ngo nkuremo?

Oya. Omeka gusa link y'inyandiko rusange kuri I Need Save, nta kwinjira ahantu na hamwe.

Nshobora gukuramo Reels ziri kuri konti yihariye?

Oya. Ibikubiyemo biri kuri konti zihariye, ibisaba kwinjira, n'ibyabujijwe mu turere tumwe ntibishobora gukurwamo. Inyandiko rusange gusa ni zo zishyigikiwe.

Nshobora kubika amafoto ari ku nyandiko ya Instagram?

Yego. Numara gukanda Kuramo, hitamo ihitamo rya Ifoto / Ifoto ntoya rigaragara ku rutonde.
